about_the_game:
The Good, The Bad & The Monkey: Welcome to the place where you'll laugh, and then laugh even more.

"The Good, The Bad & The Monkey" is a game of the good and the bad. But in this game, it's up to you to decide who's good and who's bad. In this 5-player game, you'll laugh, then laugh even more, and mostly, you'll laugh a lot. Are you ready to separate the "Good" from the "Bad"?

About the Game

  • The Good, The Bad & The Monkey is an online card game for up to 5 players. There are two types of cards in the game: Good (green) and Bad (red).

  • When players join the game, each player is dealt 5 cards, and one player is chosen as the "Killer." The main goal of the game is for the Killer to transform all players into monkeys before 4 Good cards are revealed.

Gameplay

  • A random player is chosen to start the game. The starting player creates a set of 1 to 5 cards from their hand and places it into play to begin the round. Players take turns drawing cards from this set, and the game progresses in this way.

  • If players have a Good card in front of them and reveal a Bad card, all their front cards return to their hand.

  • If players reveal a Bad card when they have no cards in front of them, the Bad card remains in front of them. The next Good card they reveal will return to their hand along with the Bad card.

  • If the Killer reveals a Bad card while having no cards in front of them, they can transform a chosen player into a monkey, eliminating them from the game. That's why bluffing is crucial when creating a set or drawing cards. You never know who the strongest will choose!

The goal for players is to reveal 4 Good cards to win, while the Killer aims to eliminate players by making them reveal Bad cards.

Why The Good, The Bad & The Monkey Are Fun

  • Interactive multiplayer experience

  • Fun gameplay focused on bluffing

  • Funny looking characters.

  • MONKEY!!!

short_description: Join the outdoor multiplayer online fun. The "Good" will win and the "Bad" will lose at this 5-person table. Can you keep your friends away from the "Good" and steer them towards the "Bad"? Life isn't always gray... And then there's the "Monkey".
supported_languages: English, German, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, French, Italian
